name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for complex systems, nurtured by his background in engineering. He honed his skills at various levels, from local racing series to international GT competitions, before finding his niche in Formula racing. His strength lies in his meticulous approach to race strategy, analyzing every conceivable scenario to optimize performance.

He joined Arrow McLaren after demonstrating his ability to turn complex data into actionable race plans that consistently delivered results. Li Wei is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to make split-second decisions that often prove to be the key to success. His focus on maximizing every opportunity and his understanding of vehicle dynamics set him apart.

physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Constantly adjusts his glasses, even when they are perfectly aligned.
Always carries a lucky abacus, though he never uses it during races.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
